kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنمحق (form VII)
# أَنْمَحِقُ (ʔanmaḥiqu) /ʔan.ma.ħi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# أَنْمَحِقَ (ʔanmaḥiqa) /ʔan.ma.ħi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
# أَنْمَحِقْ (ʔanmaḥiq) /ʔan.ma.ħiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَحَقَ (inmaḥaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
